## 7. Plan reviews of the four land-first stories (2026-09-07)

Operator approved running plan review in parallel with the experiments. Reviews ran through the async MCP starters and were polled with gate_status; after the MCP token expired (about 15:50) they ran through the local CLI, which the operator confirmed is the authorized path. Ruling recorded: there is no limit on review rounds; a "three-round rule" I had written into a scheduled poll and my scratch ledger was my invention and was corrected wherever it appeared.

Round 1 (basis 4c77d6f3e96f): all four BLOCK, every finding a grounding defect that checked out against the code.
- helpless-carnelian-megaraptor (config shim removal): _replay.py and seven tests still import the moved processor names through the shim (the plan claimed otherwise); test_processors_status_split.py asserts the re-exports; test_attach_commits.py:397 has no alias; the AC grep was unanchored. Fixed by enumerating the whole importer population (58 single-line sites in 43 files, itemised in a comment).
- gunshy-symmetric-barnacle (reconciler move): bridge_repair.py:160 loader call unscheduled; prose references in timeutils.py, _proc.py, _operation_config.py, _bridge_commands.py outside the codemod; two wrong __main__.py line cites (install_stderr_handler is at :491, the reconcile-absent branch at :344-348).
- bossy-poetic-polliwog (library annotations): no criterion covered the 22 docs edits; _lib_reads.py lacks the TextIO/Iterable/Any/os imports the new annotations need; the planned test would evaluate TYPE_CHECKING-only names and raise. Fixed: the test compares raw annotation strings from inspect.signature.
- skaldic-paradoxal-huemul (seam-guard deletion): the moved helper referenced a module alias its destination lacks; the destination imports for two moved test groups were missing.
Round 2 (basis 710a606b): bossy-poetic-polliwog PASS certified; skaldic-paradoxal-huemul PASS certified; gunshy BLOCK on two more prose references (_config_sections.py:153,208) and a path literal in an eval spec; helpless BLOCK on a miscount (fifteen remaining process_* names, not sixteen) and on deleting three shim-independent tests without stating it.
Round 3 (basis 360d504f): gunshy PASS certified; helpless BLOCK on the multi-line functional import at test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30-34, treated as prose-only.
Round 4 (basis d1bde07f): helpless BLOCK on leaf-parent containment: my plan moved two tests out of the split-guard file while the certified test-suite story it cites moves one. Round 5 narrows the move to exactly that one test and names each of the four deleted tests with its reason; it is running through the CLI as this entry is written.
Self-found defect during round 3: the acceptance grep I added used \s, which git's default regex engine does not interpret, so the check could never fail; both greps now use [[:space:]]. This is the fail-open shape the code-review guide warns about.
Certified at the end of the day: bossy-poetic-polliwog and skaldic-paradoxal-huemul (certified), gunshy-symmetric-barnacle (certified, now reading stale-code because CHANGELOG.md moved beneath it, which the claim gate accepts). Every review round's findings are folded into the story description and summarized in a comment on the story.
